notes: v472 — your device now remembers the server's last answer, so an outage is quiet instead of blank. You asked for a backup server; a second server would mean a second copy of your rules — a second place they could leak from and a second thing to drift — so instead the app keeps the ANSWER, which is not a threshold and was on your screen anyway. If our server can't be reached, today's signals come from the copy saved on your device, and the year-long grades from the last replay. Two rules it never breaks: a firing list from another day is never reused (that would be wrong, not just stale), and anything that came off your device says so with the date, every time. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
